active_ledgers.title: Ledger, plan document standardization, and plan-to-node readiness system
active_ledgers.primary_goal: Define and bootstrap the structured planning ledger, standardized Plan docs, lossless Plan conversion, PlanUnit indexing, node-readiness reporting, and simple gui_related routing.
active_ledgers.notes: Updated to use node-readiness instead of node seeds/WorkNodes and simple agent-inferred gui_related boolean.
